name: io.github.K-Dense-AI/labmcp-pfeiffer-tpg
title: Pfeiffer Vacuum Gauge Controller
description: MCP server for Pfeiffer Vacuum TPG 361/362/366 and TPG 261/262 gauge controllers.

environmentVariables.name: LABMCP_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Instrument address, e.g. serial:///dev/ttyUSB0 or tcp://192.168.1.50:5025

environmentVariables.name: LABMCP_SIMULATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use the built-in simulator (no hardware)

environmentVariables.name: LABMCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable all state-changing tools
